full-name: The Rev. William Harris Walter Bigg Wither

prefix: The Rev.
title: The Rev. William Harris Walter Bigg Wither
dates: (1809-1899)
---

curate of Otterbourne to 1871 and subsequently Rector of Hardwick, Bucks.

His father Harris Bigg Wither had proposed to Jane Austen. [R. F. Bigg-Wither, Materials for a History of the Wither Family Winchester, Warren 1907]
